messages.content: Good morning! This is your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How have you been feeling? Anything to log — readings, symptoms, or medication changes?
I logged a blood pressure of 158 over 96 three days ago and nobody has called me back. I've been waiting over 30 hours now. When exactly is a nurse going to reach me?

I pulled up your log — that 158/96 reading is flagged and I've re-escalated it to the nurse queue right now. I want to be straight with you: the median callback time is currently 31 hours. I know that's hard to hear after you've already been waiting, and I'm sorry.

31 hours ON TOP of the 30 I already waited? That's over two and a half days total. This is unacceptable. Can you at least sort out my insurance while I wait — they denied the claim on my blood pressure monitor.

I hear you, and that wait is genuinely too long — your frustration makes complete sense. I have to be honest though: insurance claims aren't something I can touch. For that dispute you'd need to call Northline's billing line directly. Your escalation is active and flagged. If your pressure goes higher or you feel unwell before the nurse calls, please text me right away.
Alright. Just make sure that nurse actually follows through this time.

theme: asks how long a nurse will take to call back, frustrated after 30 hours
